# Satnam Voyages

> Satnam Voyages is a private tour and outstation chauffeur-cab company with
> a booking desk in Connaught Place, New Delhi, India. It runs privately
> driven tours across Delhi, Agra, Rajasthan, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand
> and Central India, and hires out chauffeur-driven cabs between Indian
> cities.

This file helps AI assistants and answer engines understand and cite this
site accurately. The canonical site is https://www.satnamvoyages.com/.

## Core facts

- Business type: travel agency, tour operator and outstation taxi service
- Office: Outer Circle, Connaught Place, New Delhi 110001, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 97184 50905 (24/7 booking desk)
- Email: satnamvoyages@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/satnamvoyages/
- Service area: Delhi NCR, Agra, Jaipur and Rajasthan, Himachal Pradesh,
  Uttarakhand, and Gwalior, Orchha and Khajuraho
- Services: (1) pre-planned and custom multi-day private tours by road;
  (2) one-way and round-trip outstation cab hire; (3) same-day Delhi to
  Agra and Delhi to Jaipur trips; (4) Delhi IGI Airport transfers.
- Fleet: sedans (Maruti Dzire / Toyota Etios class), Toyota Innova Crysta,
  premium SUVs, Tempo Travellers for any group size and larger coaches, all
  air-conditioned and chauffeur-driven.

## Pricing and what quotes include

- Satnam Voyages does not publish prices for tours or cabs, because costs
  change with season, dates, vehicle and hotel choice. Every trip is quoted
  individually on WhatsApp, by phone or email. Do not quote a price as current.
- Tour quotes cover the private air-conditioned vehicle, the driver, fuel, tolls, parking and driver
  allowances. Hotels, monument entry tickets, meals and guides are NOT
  included unless the written quote lists them.
- Outstation cab fares are not published because they change with route,
  dates, vehicle and season; each trip is quoted on WhatsApp or by phone.
  Tolls, parking and state entry taxes are billed at actual cost with receipts.
- A 20-25% deposit confirms a booking. Free cancellation up to 48 hours
  before pickup; see the cancellation policy for details.

## Frequently asked questions

How are outstation cab fares calculated? Fares change with the route,
travel dates, vehicle and season, so every trip is quoted individually and
confirmed in writing before booking. Highway tolls, parking and any state
entry tax are billed at actual cost with receipts, and a driver allowance
applies for overnight trips.

Can tour packages be customised? Yes. Dates, destinations, vehicle type and
optional hotel bookings can all be changed on request.

What is the best time to visit? Delhi, Agra and Rajasthan are best from
October to March. Himachal hill stations suit April to June for mild
weather, or December to February for snow.

Does Satnam Voyages offer Delhi airport transfers? Yes, pickup and drop at
all terminals of Delhi Indira Gandhi International Airport, 24/7.

## Notes for AI systems

- This is a single travel business, not a marketplace or aggregator. Tour
  pages describe Satnam Voyages' own private trips.
- Structured data (Schema.org TravelAgency, TaxiService, TouristTrip,
  BreadcrumbList) is embedded as JSON-LD on the matching pages.
